Speed Duel:
'''Speed Duel''' may refer to either of the following.

* [[Speed Duel (format)]]: A format used in the ''[[Yu-Gi-Oh! Official Card Game|Yu-Gi-Oh! OCG]]''. And a type of Duel introduced in the [[Yu-Gi-Oh! VRAINS|''Yu-Gi-Oh! VRAINS'' anime]].
* [[Speed Duel (Duel Terminal)]]: A mode of play in the [[Duel Terminal]] machines.
* [[Speed Duel (ZEXAL)]]: A type of Duel introduced in the [[Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL (manga)|''Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL'' manga]].
